mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id, r.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_round r INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime s ON s.hyperlink_task_id=r.hyperlink_task_id AND s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE s.is_enabled=1 AND s.run_status=1 AND s.provision_status=2 AND r.round_status IN (3,4) AND r.next_dispatch_at<=#{now} ORDER BY r.next_dispatch_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_round r INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime s ON s.hyperlink_task_id=r.hyperlink_task_id AND s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE s.is_enabled=1 AND s.run_status=0 AND s.provision_status=2 AND r.round_status IN (3,10) AND r.scheduled_at<=#{now} ORDER BY r.scheduled_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_round r INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime s ON s.hyperlink_task_id=r.hyperlink_task_id AND s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE s.is_enabled=1 AND s.provision_status=2 AND s.run_status IN (0,1) AND r.round_status IN (1,3,4,5,10) AND (r.round_status NOT IN (1,10) OR r.next_dispatch_at<=#{now}) AND (r.round_status<>1 OR r.scheduled_at<=#{now}) AND (s.run_status=1 OR r.scheduled_at<=#{now}) ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_task_round (hyperlink_task_id, round_no, round_status, scheduled_at, next_dispatch_at, assigned_recipient_count, selected_account_count, actual_concurrency, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hyperlinkTaskId}, #{roundNo}, #{roundStatus}, #{scheduledAt}, #{nextDispatchAt}, #{assignedRecipientCount}, #{selectedAccountCount}, #{actualConcurrency}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hyperlink_task_round WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_status IN (1,2,3,4,5,7,10) ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM hyperlink_task_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_status IN (1,2,3,4,5,7,10) ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET scheduled_at=#{scheduledAt}, next_dispatch_at=#{scheduledAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_no=1 AND round_status IN (3,10) AND started_at IS NULL AND send_total=0

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET scheduled_at=#{now}, next_dispatch_at=#{now}, round_status=CASE WHEN round_status IN (7,10) THEN 3 ELSE round_status END, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_status IN (1,3,7,10)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET selected_account_count=#{selectedCount}, actual_concurrency=#{actualConcurrency}, round_status=#{roundStatus}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND round_status=2

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round r SET assigned_recipient_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id), send_total=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.submitted_at IS NOT NULL), success_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.send_status BETWEEN 3 AND 5), delivered_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.send_status BETWEEN 4 AND 5), read_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.send_status=5), fail_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.send_status IN (6,7)), fail_404_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id AND x.send_status=7), last_send_at=(SELECT MAX(x.submitted_at) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=r.id), updated_at=#{now} WHERE r.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET assigned_recipient_count=assigned_recipient_count+#{delta.assignedRecipientDelta}, send_total=send_total+#{delta.sendDelta}, success_num=success_num+#{delta.successDelta}, delivered_num=delivered_num+#{delta.deliveredDelta}, read_num=read_num+#{delta.readDelta}, fail_num=fail_num+#{delta.failedDelta}, fail_404_num=fail_404_num+#{delta.fail404Delta}, last_send_at=CASE WHEN #{delta.lastSendAt} IS NULL THEN last_send_at WHEN last_send_at IS NULL THEN #{delta.lastSendAt} ELSE GREATEST(last_send_at,#{delta.lastSendAt}) END, updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{delta.tenantId} AND id=#{delta.roundId} AND hyperlink_task_id=#{delta.taskId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hyperlink_task_round WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_status=8 AND send_total=0
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET round_status=2, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND round_status=#{expectedStatus}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET selected_account_count=#{selectedCount}, actual_concurrency=#{actualConcurrency}, round_status=#{roundStatus}, next_dispatch_at=#{nextDispatchAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND round_status=2
UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET round_status=4, started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{now}), last_send_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND round_status IN (3,4)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_round r SET round_status=6, dispatch_completed_at=COALESCE(dispatch_completed_at,#{now}), finished_at=#{now}, actual_concurrency=0, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE r.id=#{id} AND r.round_status IN (3,4,5,10) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_round_id=#{id} AND x.send_status=2)
UPDATE hyperlink_task_round SET round_status=7, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND round_status IN (3,4,5)
